topic.source_contract: Mineral safeguarding and coal-mining legacy planning evidence

facts.purpose: avoid needless sterilisation of mineral resources
facts.guard: safeguarding is not a presumption resources will be worked

facts.policy: define Mineral Safeguarding and Consultation Areas
facts.guard: known resource location is not extraction permission

facts.high_risk: most development needs Coal Mining Risk Assessment
facts.guard: map status is not a site investigation result

facts.definition: recorded coal-mining features at surface or shallow depth

facts.guard: information access is not risk clearance

scope_guards: Mineral Safeguarding Areas do not create a presumption of extraction.
Mineral Consultation Areas are consultation triggers and not title or planning outcomes.
Mineral extraction requires planning permission and other permits or approvals.
Coal Development High Risk Area geometry is screening and not measured site condition.
A Coal Mining Risk Assessment is not a ground investigation or remediation certificate.
Development Low Risk Area is not proof that no mining feature or subsidence risk exists.
Coal records and mineral ownership are distinct from surface HMLR title ownership.
No score or promotion is written without exact local policy, coal records, investigation and planning evidence.
